timing: one row per retargeted step; steps follow the 19.94 Hz capture clock and are stamped at a nominal 20 Hz
pelvis: observation.state 43-49: pelvis position (robot world) and orientation quaternion xyzw

verdicts.held: the product stays in the hand
verdicts.slipped: it moves more than 60 mm in the hand
verdicts.lost: fewer than two hand links touch it for 3 steps
verdicts.no_carry: the product is not carried in this hold
